reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend / getDayWithSkippedWeekend helpers with holidays and reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, parseDate and RSchedule, adding small shared helpers (skipsWeekendOccurrences, isNonWorkingDay, getDailyTakeCount) in shared/schedules.ts.

duplication.why: The 'daily schedules drop non-working occurrences, others move them' dispatch is written separately in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange (each with its own dropsWeekendDays ? filter(isNonWorkingDay) : getDateWithSkippedWeekend branch), and schedule-template encodes it a fourth way via noSkipWeekend.

placement.why: Rule helpers live in shared/schedules.ts and the handler next to getUpcomingDates; only the per-caller dispatch sits in server code rather than in the shared rule.

scope.why: Focused on schedule date resolution, the new handler, types and tests; the small renames inside getNextDate are incidental.

maintainability.why: Building blocks are shared, but because the skip-vs-move decision is not one function every caller must remember both halves, and the look-ahead/shift constants differ between getDailyTakeCount and getDatesInRange's padding.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Moves go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend / getDayWithSkippedWeekend; daily skips go through the new shared isNonWorkingDay / skipsWeekendOccurrences.

disguised_duplication.where: The skip-or-move dispatch is reshaped in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate (early find), server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates (ternary over arrays) and getDatesInRange (loop with continue), plus schedule-template's noSkipWeekend flag.

abstraction_drift.where: holidays parameter added to getDateWithSkippedWeekend and getDayWithSkippedWeekend; getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange each branch on skipsWeekendOccurrences and filter with isNonWorkingDay instead of one shared resolve-occurrence function.
